definitions.gloss: winning a prize, placing in a competition
definitions.explanation: Finishing in a prize-winning position in a contest, competition, or tournament. Does not necessarily mean first place — any placement that earns a prize or recognition counts.

examples.japanese: ⟦コンクール→コンクール：28795_konkuuru⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{入賞|にゅうしょう}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I won a prize at the contest.

examples.japanese: ⟦{娘|むすめ}→娘：02263_musume⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{絵画|かいが}→絵画：02597_kaiga⟧⟦コンテスト→コンテスト：03843_kontesuto⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{入賞|にゅうしょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{果|は}たした→果たす：10060_hatasu⟧。
examples.english: My daughter placed in the painting contest.

examples.japanese: {入賞|にゅうしょう}⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{賞金|しょうきん}→賞金：14234_shoukin⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{記念品|きねんひん}→記念品：03049_kinenhin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{贈|おく}られる→贈る：09862_okuru⟧。
examples.english: Prize money and a commemorative gift will be awarded to the winners.

notes:
Covers any prize-winning placement, not just first place. Often used with specific competitions like ⟦コンクール→コンクール：28795_konkuuru⟧, ⟦コンテスト→コンテスト：03843_kontesuto⟧, ⟦{大会|たいかい}→大会：03386_taikai⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {入賞|にゅうしょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{果|は}たす→果たす：10060_hatasu⟧ (achieve a prize-winning placement)
- {入賞|にゅうしょう}⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧ (prize winner)
- {入賞|にゅうしょう}⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧ (prize-winning work)
- {入賞|にゅうしょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{逃|のが}す→逃す：04611_nogasu⟧ (miss out on a prize)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {入賞|にゅうしょう}: placing in a competition (any prize-winning rank)
- ⟦{優勝|ゆうしょう}→優勝：03647_yuushou⟧: winning first place, championship
- ⟦{受賞|じゅしょう}→受賞：11867_jushou⟧: receiving a specific named award or prize
